Package index

Networks

Build a network once from a directory with an OpenStreetMap .pbf and GTFS feeds.

build_network()
Build a transport network

Travel times

Travel-time matrices by street or by public transport, summarised over the departure window or trip by trip.

travel_time_matrix()
Calculate travel time matrix between origin destination pairs considering a departure time
expanded_travel_time_matrix()
Calculate minute-by-minute travel times between origin destination pairs
arrival_travel_time_matrix()
Calculate travel time matrix between origin destination pairs considering a time of arrival

Accessibility

accessibility()
Calculate access to opportunities

Fares

Fare structures (how much each ride and transfer costs), which the routing functions take, and the trade-off between travel time and fare.

setup_fare_structure()
Setup a fare structure to calculate the monetary costs of trips
read_fare_structure()
Read a fare structure object from a file
write_fare_structure()
Write a fare structure object to disk
pareto_frontier()
Calculate travel time and monetary cost Pareto frontier

Isochrones and itineraries

The areas or street segments reached from each origin within each cutoff, and the legs of each trip.

isochrone()
Estimate isochrones from a given location
detailed_itineraries()
Detailed itineraries between origin-destination pairs

Trip options

A multi-criteria trip planner: every trip worth considering on time, fare, transfers and walking.

trip_options()
Trip options between origin-destination pairs

Facility location

Where to open new facilities (maximal covering, set covering, p-median, p-center), and supply against demand around each place (two-step floating catchment area).

locate_facilities()
Choose where to open new facilities
floating_catchment()
Supply against demand around each place: the two-step floating catchment area

Inspecting a network

Where points snap, the street and transit networks as sf, the dates with service, and the errors gtfs-lib finds in the feeds.

find_snap()
Find snapped locations of input points on street network
street_network_bbox()
Extract the geographic bounding box of the transport network
street_network_to_sf()
Extract OpenStreetMap network in sf format
transit_network_to_sf()
Extract transit network in sf format
check_transit_availability()
Check transit service availability by date
get_gtfs_errors()
Get GTFS errors encountered in network building

The package

peabiru peabiru-package
peabiru: multimodal routing on OpenStreetMap and GTFS networks
core_version()
Version of the Rust routing core
